title: Projection and contraction methods with double inertial steps for variational inclusion problems on Hilbert spaces
summary: In this paper, we propose three projection--contraction algorithms for solving variational inclusion problems in the setting of Hilbert spaces, each incorporating a double inertial technique into the projection--contraction framework. The first algorithm \algoO achieves weak convergence under monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity of the single-valued operator, with an adaptive stepsize rule that does not require prior knowledge of the Lipschitz constant.
